auth.title: DKV@Home Sign in
auth.description:
**Important first:** open the browser DevTools (F12) → **Network** tab → check **“Preserve log”**.

1. Click the login link: [Sign in to DKV]({auth_url})
2. Sign in to DKV
3. Afterwards the browser seems to do nothing, or shows a blank page or an error – that is normal. If the browser asks whether to open the DKV app → **Cancel**. Do not close the tab with the DevTools
4. In the Network tab click the entry **“authenticate?…”** (POST, status 302) → section **Response Headers** → copy the value of **`Location`** (starts with `com.dkv-mobility.app://oauth2redirect?code=…`)
5. Paste the URL below

> If the code has expired, a new login link is generated automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. Please check your internet connection and try again.
error.code_expired: Code expired or already used – a new login link has been generated. Please click the new link FROM THE FORM and sign in again!
error.wrong_auth_url: The code belongs to a different login link (wrong tab or old link). A new link has been generated. Please click the link FROM THE FORM and sign in again!
error.invalid_input: Invalid input. Please paste the full redirect URL (with ?code=…) or a refresh token (starts with 'eyJ').
error.invalid_redirect_url: No authorization code found in the URL. Please paste the full redirect URL.
error.unknown: Unknown error. Check the HA logs for details.
error.invalid_token: The pasted refresh token is invalid or has expired. Please log in again and paste the redirect URL.
